name: Lenient Digital Asset Review Rubric
purpose: Supports early blockout reviews where fast iteration and readable gameplay affordances matter more than final material polish.

criteria.description: Assets should read clearly from the primary review camera, even if secondary angles are rough.
Basic color and roughness choices should communicate intent without requiring final shading.
Agents should be able to route around blockout geometry without obvious clipping.
The asset should trigger useful behavior or inspection events during prototype reviews.
Prototype assets should stay simple enough for rapid capture and replay workflows.
